item.title: 🌹 The Way of the Heart & The Way of the Rubbles: NFTs That Speak for Palestine
item.description:
In a world where digital art meets activism, two NFTs emerge not just as visual statements—but as emotional testaments to resilience, love, and memory.

💗 The Way of the Heart

A heart, tender yet enduring, cradles a blooming rose. This NFT symbolizes the quiet strength of compassion, the beauty that persists even in pain. The rose grows from the heart—not despite it, but because of it. It’s a tribute to those who choose love in the face of loss, and to the emotional roots that nourish resistance.
